scope: Optional private source-manifest download protocol and accepted async completion
evidence_policy: Fresh current-candidate checks and actual separate-invocation review govern this component. This report grants no executed or parent pass.
controls: Strict exact model/commit/source/digest presence precedes effects; omission retains ordinary behavior. Same-worker manifest capability is required before task POST. Copied frozen source expectations survive readiness and capability waits.

The existing bounded accepted-download owner retains the original manifest; completion compares target, digest and canonical cache handle before filesystem resolution. An unassociated manifest marker denies. No new ownership map or public approval operation is introduced.

The worker selects literal safe files in the explicit validated prepared host cache, uses token=False and one SDK worker, and retains existing format/size guards. Existing extra/corrupt data denies without cache cleanup, fallback, alias replacement or application retry.

Actual temporary files exercise bounded size/hash/EOF and stable path/descriptor facts. Metadata hashes use the Git blob header; weights require SHA256. Index selection is bounded and closed, rejects escapes and duplicate keys. Windows path/handle ctime is separately guarded against each API's baseline.
Declared free-space admission remains conservative metadata-based admission, not a hard network/disk quota. Verified-at-read bytes are separate from native custody, later loading and quality.
retained_failures: The first DTO import through tasks triggered that package's existing eager imports and a circular models import. Canonical wire DTOs moved into worker models.py; the task helper imports those completed definitions. No worker task initialization policy changed.

A real Windows fixture exposed different ctime observations between path and descriptor stat APIs. Their common file identity facts are compared across APIs; each full ctime baseline remains checked before/after within its own API. Growing/replaced files and descriptor drift still deny.
Initial strict TypeScript checking found three untyped fixture callback parameters. Explicit types corrected the tests; no production check or compiler option changed.

The sandbox stalled the existing authenticated worker HTTP fixture. The owned run was stopped and its log retained; the same controlled manifest/revision set passed outside the sandbox without external network or model execution.

Independent preflight found an implicit SDK cache destination, missing accepted async manifest association and an unbound completion handle. The implementation binds cache_dir, carries the frozen accepted expectation and checks the exact canonical handle, with focused regression fixtures. Final governed checks/review remain required.
qualification_limits: The Windows relative-symlink probe was unavailable with winerror1314. This component claims actual regular-file and controlled protocol evidence only; it adds no native symlink/lifetime qualification or guard relaxation.
No external/model download, real weights, runtime activation, generation, training or output accuracy was exercised. Existing accepted accuracy results remain closed.
Unauthenticated transfer does not establish public provenance, license rights or private/gated credential support. Cached bytes do not gain those properties.

Public plan admission, actual transfer/resource enforcement, task recovery/presentation and physical model/host outcomes remain I7 work. No Model package, increment or parent criterion is closed by this private prerequisite.
